column3: set the pace from the off - driven two furlongs out - stayed on to win
sat in second early - pushed along two furlongs out - conceded the position close home - rallied for second at the line

settled at the rear early - made headway into third with three furlongs left - driven two furlongs out and closed on the leading pair towards the finish - denied by the winner and beaten a length and a half into third
up with the pace in fourth early - driven two out but made no further gain inside the final 110 yards
tracked the leaders in third early - dropped back with three furlongs left - pressed for a response two out - faded from the furlong marker and untroubled to the line
raced in the pack early - made ground down the inner before the 2f marker - shaken up in third and quickened through the final furlong - grabbed the lead close home

took up the running - came under pressure with 2f to run and had a rival to fend off - dug in gamely - driven out approaching the final furlong - overhauled close home and unable to live with the winner's turn of foot
raced close to the pace - went up to challenge with 2f to run and still going strongly approaching the final furlong - weakened inside the final 110 yards to be denied second
raced up with the front group out wide - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - stayed on at the same speed through the final furlong
dwelt at the start and was soon settled at the back of the field - made ground down the inner under pressure passing the 2f marker - continued at one speed from the furlong marker
raced towards the back of the field - driven hard before the furlong marker - found nothing under pressure
raced up with the front runners - driven along passing the 2f marker before fading right out of contention
sat handy up the far rail without company - shared the front 2f out - went clear over 1f out - held on for the win
held up towards the back - driven into contention over 1f out - looked the likely winner entering the final furlong - edged right and held on for second beaten a length and a half
tracked the front two early - asked for effort 2f out and drifted right as the front group went by over 1f out - stayed on without matching the front two to finish third beaten two lengths
raced in the pack - drifted left while improving into contention over 2f out - in pursuit of the front-runners over 1f out - faded inside the final 110yds beaten four and a half lengths in fourth

went down the middle and quickly hit the front - was overtaken over 1f out then pressed for effort inside the final furlong - faded inside the final 110yds to finish fifth beaten four and a half lengths
held up towards the back and soon lost touch with the pace from over 1f out - drifted left and faded inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten ten and a half lengths
led from the break - urged for effort 2f out - driven out and stayed on strongly from over 1f out
up with the front-runner - second at halfway - asked for effort 3f out - found little more and edged right early in the straight - stayed on one gear from over 1f out without troubling the winner
settled in the pack - fourth at halfway - shaken up on the inner and up to third over 1f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
held up towards the back - improved into fifth 2f out and fourth early in the straight - found nothing more and held that gear from over 1f out
held up at the back - urged on the inner early in the straight and up to fifth by 1f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
up with the front pair - third at halfway - asked for effort 3f out and faded over 2f out
settled towards the back in fifth at halfway - asked for effort on the outer 2f out - driven without response and faded from over 1f out
settled just off the pace early - driven two furlongs out and hit the front approaching the furlong marker - found more to win
sat just behind the pace early - pushed along approaching the final furlong and up into second - responded but unable to peg back the winner
up with the leaders early - pressed for a response inside the final furlong - stayed on without quickening in third
set the pace from the break - driven approaching the final furlong and lost the advantage there - dropped away inside the final 110 yards
settled at the rear early - dropped away with two furlongs left - made up late ground but was not involved in the finish
led from the off - driven out passing the furlong marker and drifted right - ran on strongly to win with something in hand
raced up with the front group - asked for effort inside the final 2f - kept finding more to move into second late on - unable to land a blow on the winner
raced close to the pace - asked for effort with 2f to run and found more - had nothing left to give inside the final furlong
took a while to get going - raced at the back of the field - played no part in the finish
dwelt at the start - raced towards the back of the field throughout
raced up with the leading duo - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - faded approaching the final furlong
dwelt at the start - settled towards the back early - made progress out wide from 1f out - finished strongly - hit the front inside the final 110yds and scored comfortably
up with the pace and soon in second - went to the front over 1f out - was driven along when overtaken inside the final 110yds - had no more to give and was second at the finish beaten a length
raced in the pack - made ground on the front two from over 1f out - stayed on in pursuit of the front two inside the final 110yds to finish third beaten three and a quarter lengths
edged into a slender advantage early - was overtaken 1f out - faded quickly to finish fourth beaten four lengths
sat in the pack early - lost touch with the pace 2f out and slipped to last over 1f out - was adrift of the pack inside the final furlong to finish fifth beaten six and a quarter lengths
up with the pace and over-eager early - was ridden over 1f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten ten and a quarter lengths
raced in the pack - was ridden over 1f out - was boxed in and unable to find a run inside the final furlong - faded fast to finish seventh beaten ten and three-quarter lengths
raced in the pack early before fading and being boxed in for room inside the final furlong - dropped away quickly to finish last beaten seventeen and three-quarter lengths
up with the front pair - third at halfway - made ground into second by 2f out - hit the front over 1f out - stayed on strongly to win comfortably inside the final furlong
up with the front-runner - second at halfway - urged into the front by 2f out - asked again and lost that spot over 1f out - stayed on one gear inside the final furlong without troubling the winner
held up towards the back - fourth at halfway - asked for effort 2f out - stayed on to improve into third near the finish
set the pace early - asked for effort and overtaken 2f out - found nothing more in third by 1f out and dropped back again near the line
at the back of the field throughout - made no impact on the race
settled off the pace early - made steady headway with two furlongs left - driven approaching the final furlong to go clear - asserted to score
settled in the chasing pack early - improved to the front approaching the final furlong before being overtaken with a furlong to run - stayed on again but unable to reel in the winner
settled just behind the pace early - short of room with two furlongs left - angled left to work into third with a furlong to run and found more to the line
set the pace from the break - driven with two furlongs left and lost the advantage approaching the final furlong - faded in the final furlong
up with the pace early - driven two furlongs out and faded approaching the final furlong
settled off the pace - pressed for a response with two furlongs left but made no real impact

slow to begin - settled in the pack - made ground down the inner before the 2f marker - up into second with 1f to run - quickened to the front entering the final furlong and drew clear for a comfortable win
settled in the pack - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - driven and finished well to go second inside the final 110 yards - came up short of the winner
raced up with the front runners - asked for effort with 2f to run - kept on without ever threatening up front
took up the running - came under pressure with 2f to run and was passed entering the last furlong - continued at the same speed to the finish
raced close to the pace - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - dropped away steadily thereafter
stumbled at the start - raced at the back of the field - asked for effort before the 2f marker and dropped right out of contention
up with the pace in the middle of the field - moved through easily to hit the front inside the final furlong - drew away for a comfortable success

went to the front from the middle of the field early - was ridden over 1f out - was overtaken inside the final furlong - stayed on but could not get on terms with the winner beaten two lengths in second

up with the pace in the middle of the field - was driven and still holding a winning position 1f out - was driven hard inside the final furlong but had no more to give to finish third beaten four and a half lengths
raced second among three up the near rail - was ridden over 1f out and stayed on without matching the front three inside the final 110yds to finish fourth beaten six and three-quarter lengths
held a position at the back up the stand rail throughout and made no impact to finish fifth beaten seven and a quarter lengths
drifted right from the stalls - set the pace up the near rail - edged left as the pace told over 1f out - faded quickly to finish sixth beaten twelve and a quarter lengths

drifted right from the stalls - raced towards the back of the middle bunch - lost touch with the pace from over 1f out and faded fast inside the final 110yds to finish seventh beaten thirteen and a half lengths

held up towards the back - fifth at halfway - up into fourth by 3f out - made headway into second over 2f out - driven into the front over 1f out - held on under a renewed challenge and needed every yard near the finish

sent to the front from the break - overtaken after 1 furlong - in a scrap for the front at halfway - opened a clear gap over 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - driven and overtaken again over 1f out - fought back near the finish but narrowly denied
up with the front pair - fourth at halfway - urged on the inner and up to third by 1f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort 3f out and fifth entering the straight - up to fourth by 1f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
settled in the pack - made headway into third by halfway - asked for effort in second 3f out - found nothing more and faded over 2f out
up with the front-runner early and went on after 1 furlong - caught at halfway - asked for effort and overtaken 3f out - found nothing more and faded
at the back of the field for the whole trip - took no part in the finish

settled in the pack early - driven with two furlongs left and began to make ground approaching the final furlong - up into second and closing on the pacesetter inside the final 110 yards - got up to win on the line
up with the pace early - driven to the front approaching the final furlong - battled hard through the final 110 yards but was caught on the line
made the running early before being driven and losing the advantage approaching the final furlong - held on for third without finding extra
settled off the pace early - driven approaching the final furlong - made up ground into fourth inside the final 110 yards and finished well
settled off the leaders early - driven approaching the final furlong - made late progress into fifth close home without ever looking likely to trouble the principals
up with the pace early - pressed for a response and put into contention approaching the final furlong - dropped away in the final 110 yards
settled in the pack early - dropped away with three furlongs left - pressed for a response with two furlongs left but made no impression from the furlong marker
settled at the back early - asked for effort by halfway - made rapid gains with 1f to run under a drive - moved into second with 110 yards left before hitting the front close home
set the pace - driven along with 1f to run and kicked clear - caught and passed close home
raced towards the back - asked for effort by halfway and finished strongly from the furlong marker - kept the placing to the finish
raced up with the front runners - asked for effort with 1f to run - continued at one speed to the finish
raced prominently - dropped away from the one in front with 1f to run - faded in the final 110 yards
raced up with the front runners - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - dropped away with 1f to run
settled in the pack - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - never got competitive

settled towards the back - slipped to last for a spell 2f out - was denied room over 1f out - found a gap to the right and surged to the front approaching the final furlong - finished strongly to score with plenty in hand

raced wide early - moved right in a hurry to hit the front after 1f - was ridden when overtaken over 1f out - stayed in pursuit of the winner inside the final furlong - had nothing more to give to finish second beaten two and a quarter lengths
tracked the front-runner early in second - was driven 2f out - was asked for more over 1f out but lost touch with the front two inside the final 110yds to finish third beaten three and a half lengths

set the pace early - was caught by a short margin after 1f and dropped back to third - was driven over 1f out - came under pressure inside the final furlong - drifted left and faded inside the final 110yds to finish fourth beaten seven and a half lengths
settled at the back - was driven for a shade of progress over 1f out before fading fast inside the final furlong to finish fifth beaten ten and three-quarter lengths
raced no closer than the pack - lost touch with the pace from over 1f out and slipped to last inside the final furlong - trailed home sixth beaten fifteen and a quarter lengths
up with the front pair - third at halfway - asked for effort when short of room for a moment early in the straight - up to second by 1f out - hit the front over 100 yards out and stayed on strongly
shared the front early - asked for effort entering the straight - overtaken over 1f out and found nothing more in third by 100 yards out - fought back to regain second near the finish

up with the front pair - fourth at halfway - asked for effort and edged right for a moment early in the straight - driven on over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong to move into third near the finish
shared the front early - asked for effort entering the straight - opened a clear gap over 1f out - found nothing more and overtaken by 100 yards out before slipping back two more spots near the line
settled towards the back of the pack - fifth at halfway - found nothing more and held that gear from over 2f out
slow to break - at the back of the field throughout - took no part in the finish
held up towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - driven without making any impact from over 1f out
settled at the back of the field early - pressed for a response with two furlongs left before finding a run between rivals to go clear approaching the final furlong - kept finding to win
up with the pace early - driven approaching the final furlong to go to the front - overtaken inside the final 110 yards and could not reel in the winner
set the pace from the break - pressed for a response approaching the final furlong and lost the advantage there - dropped away in the final 110 yards
up with the pace early - driven with two furlongs left and faded in the final furlong
settled at the back of the field early - driven and drifted right with two furlongs left - well held from there
settled in the pack and short of room passing the 2f marker - found a gap and made ground with 1f to run - quickened smartly to hit the front close home
raced close to the pace in second - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - continued finding more under a drive with 1f to run - hit the front with 110 yards left before being caught close home
set the pace - driven along with 1f to run - caught with 110 yards left and dropped away
raced up with the front runners on the inside - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - driven and continued at the same gait with 1f to run
raced up with the front group out wide - asked for effort passing the 2f marker without ever threatening while drifting left - dropped away inside the final furlong
raced towards the back - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - found nothing under pressure
slow to begin - raced at the back - asked for effort and dropped away passing the 2f marker
tracked the pace in second early - was driven to close on the front-runner 2f out - went to the front 1f out - stayed on strongly to win with something in hand

was driven to the front early - was overtaken after 1f - was driven for effort once more over 4f out - was niggled at and slipped to last for a moment 1f out - responded with a change of direction to the left inside the final 110yds - moved into second close home but could not get to the winner in the closing strides beaten a length and three-quarters
settled at the back - made ground over 1f out - was pushed along inside the final furlong but lost touch with the front two towards the finish to come home third beaten three and a half lengths

up with the pace - went to the front after 1f - was driven when tested 2f out - was under pressure when overtaken over 1f out - lost touch with the front-runners inside the final 110yds and had nothing more to give to finish fourth beaten four lengths
led from the break - asked for effort entering the straight - stayed on strongly from over 1f out
settled in the pack - fourth at halfway - asked for effort and up to third by 2f out - stayed on from over 1f out to move into second near the finish
up with the front-runner - second at halfway - asked for effort 2f out - found nothing more from over 1f out and slipped to third near the finish
slow to break - held up towards the back - asked for effort 3f out and fifth by 1f out - up to fourth over 150 yards out - found nothing more and held that gear near the finish
up with the front pair - third at halfway - asked for effort on the inner 2f out - found nothing more in fourth by 1f out and dropped another spot over 150 yards out
settled in the pack - fifth at halfway and up to fourth for a moment out wide entering the straight - found nothing more and faded over 1f out
set the pace early before being overtaken with four furlongs left - regained the front with two furlongs left - drew away inside the final furlong - scored without being pressed
slowly away and settled at the rear - angled right and pressed for a response with two furlongs left - up into second inside the final furlong - but never able to land a blow on the winner

sat just behind the pace early - pressed for a response with two furlongs left - in pursuit of the winner approaching the final furlong - unable to make further inroads and dropped out of second inside the final furlong
raced keenly and settled off the pace - put into the race and drifted right with two furlongs left - faded inside the final furlong
raced up with the pacesetter early before going on with four furlongs left - lost the advantage with two furlongs left - dropped away with a furlong left

led from the start - asked for effort passing the 2f marker and drew further ahead - drifted right with 1f to run - the rider lost the stick approaching the final 110 yards - ran on strongly for a comfortable success
raced close to the pace - asked for effort with 3f to run - stayed on but was second best throughout
dwelt at the start - settled at the back - moved into fourth with 3f to run under pressure - kept going without ever threatening the front
taken back early - made ground to reach the front group after 4 furlongs - asked for effort passing the 2f marker and dropped away with 1f to run
settled in the pack out wide - asked for effort with 4f to run - out of contention with 2f to run
raced up with the leading duo - dropped back and was asked for effort with 4f to run - found nothing under pressure
settled in the pack - asked for effort with 4f to run - dropped away rapidly with 3f to run
gripped bit in the early stages - settled midpack - advanced steadily to loom upsides the pacesetter 2f out - pushed along and rallied to prevail close home
up with the pace early - went to the front approaching 3f out - driven along 2f out and opened a length advantage entering the last furlong - battled on but caught close home
slow to begin at the back of the field - pushed along 3f out and improved to third with 1f left - unable to challenge the front pair
racing in mid-division - pushed along 3f out - began fading from 2f out
set the pace early - pushed along beyond 3f out and quickly passed - faded from 2f out

tracked the pace-setter - was driven strongly over 3f out - was asked for effort and hit the front over 2f out - opened a decisive advantage over 1f out - was allowed to idle to the line for an easy win

dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - was driven and losing ground 3f out - was under pressure over 2f out - moved right over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening the clear-cut winner to finish second beaten four and a quarter lengths
tracked the front-runners - was driven over 3f out and under continued pressure over 2f out - stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong to finish third beaten eight lengths

set the pace - was driven over 3f out - came under pressure and was overtaken over 2f out - faded quickly and had nothing more to offer inside the final furlong to finish fourth thirteen lengths off the winner
held up towards the back - was driven 3f out and under continued pressure over 2f out - never landed a blow on the pace throughout to finish fifth thirteen and three-quarter lengths off the winner
up with the front-runner - second at halfway - asked for effort 2f out and hit the front over 1f out - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong
up with the front pair - fifth at halfway - made headway into third by 2f out - driven up to second over 100 yards out and held that gear near the finish
held up towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - up to sixth by 1f out and fourth over 100 yards out - improved into third near the finish
up with the front pair - asked for effort in fourth 2f out and slipped to fifth by 100 yards out - fought back to reclaim fourth near the finish
up with the front pair - fourth at halfway - asked for effort in fifth 2f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort 2f out - stayed on to move into sixth near the finish
set the pace early - asked for effort 2f out - driven and overtaken over 1f out with nothing more to give in third by 100 yards out - faded near the finish
settled towards the back of the pack - asked for effort out wide entering the straight and again over 1f out - found nothing more and held that gear inside the final furlong
settled in the pack - sixth at halfway - asked for effort on the inner early in the straight - found nothing more over 1f out and faded inside the final furlong
at the back of the field throughout - took no part in the finish
held up towards the back - asked for effort 2f out - made no impact and allowed to drop away over 1f out
mid-division early - ridden along and made ground 2f out - finishing well through the last furlong - got up close home

up with the pace early - dropped away from 2f out - driven along entering the final furlong - rallied into second inside the final 110 yards - briefly in front near the finish - caught in the last strides and beaten into second
up with the pace and sent to the front 2f out - battled on through the final furlong - overtaken close home to finish a length and a quarter back in third
mid-division early - moved into second 2f out before being driven along to chase the pacesetter - faded back and had nothing more to give close home to finish fourth
settled towards the back of the field - made ground from 2f out - pushed along but couldn't quicken again in the final furlong to finish fifth
settled just off the pace early - urged forward from 2f out and moved ahead of tiring others in the final furlong - without ever threatening for a place and finished sixth
settled towards the back of the field - toiling from 2f out and always adrift to finish seventh
sent to the front early - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - faded into the final furlong to finish eighth
raced in mid-division early - pushed along from 2f out - dropped away quickly to finish ninth
sat handy early - angled off the rail and made smooth headway to loom up with three furlongs left - went to the front with two furlongs left - kept finding under little pressure to score
short of room early and settled in third - angled left to move into second with two furlongs left - drifted right in the final furlong and stayed on for second without landing a blow on the winner
made the running from the start - driven with three furlongs left and lost the advantage with two furlongs left - faded inside the final furlong
set the pace early - lost the advantage at halfway - dropped away 4f out - driven along over 2f out - angled right inside the final furlong - rallied to win in the last strides
dropped in at the back early - made steady progress from 4f out - was driven up into second inside the final furlong - edged in front 200 yards out before being overhauled close home
travelled handy - third at halfway - improved to the front under pressure over 2f out - came under strong driving over 1f out - lost the advantage and faded inside the final furlong
held up at the back - 10th at halfway - travelled wide of the field - asked for effort 3f out and angled out to make ground 2f out - finished well
sat behind the pace - travelled keenly early - eased back to sixth by halfway - down in tenth and given a squeeze 3f out - improved to fourth over 2f out - found nothing more up the run-in
handy in the early stages - fifth at halfway - asked for more 3f out - dropped away over 1f out and never threatened
settled at the back - improved into eighth by halfway and up to third over 3f out - driven and faded fast over 2f out - never threatened
midfield early and travelling keenly - fourth at halfway - improved into second 5f out - hit the front 4f out - overtaken and faded fast over 2f out
racing in midfield - seventh at halfway - given a squeeze over 3f out - faded from 2f out without threatening
midfield early - ninth at halfway - driven and faded over 4f out to finish well beaten
midfield and travelling keenly wide of the field early - made ground after 3f to hit the front at halfway - faded fast over 4f out and finished well beaten
travelled close up early - advanced easily to hit the front 2f out - shaken up and drew away in the closing stages
made the running early - driven along beyond 3f out - overtaken 2f out and soon lost touch with the new leader - stayed on at one speed through the last furlong
handy early - pushed along in pursuit beyond 3f out - stayed on at one speed passing the final furlong

raced in the pack - was niggled along and made noticeable progress over 2f out - came under pressure 2f out - showed signs of inexperience but went to the front over 1f out - stayed on strongly for an untroubled win inside the final furlong

was over-eager early and settled towards the back - was driven and made progress from over 3f out - was pressed for more over 1f out - stayed on without getting close to the winner to finish second beaten two and a quarter lengths
up with the pace out wide - came under pressure 3f out - lost touch with the front over 1f out - kept on to finish closest of the beaten horses in third beaten three and three-quarter lengths

tracked the pace-setter - came under pressure 3f out - lost touch with the pace over 2f out - was hampered inside the final furlong - made little show until finding more ground late to come home fourth beaten four and a quarter lengths

held up towards the back - was driven and made progress 3f out - was under pressure and showed inexperience 2f out - edged left from over 1f out and stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong to finish fifth beaten five and a quarter lengths

travelled over-eager and went straight to the front - came under pressure 2f out - was overtaken over 1f out - stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong - but dropped back three positions close home to finish sixth beaten six lengths

raced in the pack - was driven for a small amount of progress 3f out then came under further pressure but lost touch with the pace 2f out - faded inside the final furlong to finish seventh beaten eighteen lengths

dwelt at the start and settled last - pulled keenly in the early stages - made ground from 2f out - went to the front approaching the final 110yds - ran on strongly and quickened clear towards the finish
settled in second early - went to the front 3f out - asked to quicken over 1f out - under pressure when overtaken approaching the final 110yds then faded but clung on for second towards the finish
settled in third - asked for effort 2f out - in pursuit of the front pair over 1f out then denied room briefly in the final furlong - shifted to the middle of the track and rallied towards the finish
settled towards the back - gained on the front group 3f out then urged for effort 2f out - unable to hold the pace over 1f out and faded fast inside the final furlong
went straight to the front - given a squeeze when overtaken 3f out and faded fast over 1f out - was soon far adrift
held up towards the back - asked for effort out wide and up to second by 2f out - stayed on strongly inside the final furlong to hit the front over 100 yards out

held up towards the back - made ground into third by halfway - improved into the front over 2f out - asked for effort over 1f out - found nothing more and overtaken by 100 yards out but held that gear to the finish

slow into stride - soon up with the front-runner - fourth at halfway - checked in stride after a stumble over 2f out - made ground on the inner when short of room over 1f out - shifted off the rail and responded once more inside the final furlong to move into third over 50 yards out

up with the front pair - made ground into second by halfway - asked for effort and stumbled at the marker over 2f out - found nothing more in third by 1f out and dropped another spot over 50 yards out

set the pace early - asked for effort and overtaken over 2f out - drifted right and interfered with another runner on the rail over 1f out - found nothing more in fourth over 1f out and dropped another spot over 50 yards out

midfield and travelling wide early - improved into third by halfway - mistake at the 11th - made further ground to edge in front before 3 out - went on before 2 out - kept finding more to win with something in hand

settled at the back and travelled wide early - up to ninth by halfway - made further gains from the 11th - into third and driven from 3 out - drifted right under pressure after 2 out - stayed on but never good enough to trouble the winner

set out in front before being overtaken at the first - back in command before the 4th - a length up at halfway - passed again before 5 out - driven before 3 out - dropped out of second and faded after 2 out
handy early - fourth at halfway - mistake at the 6th - drifted right 3 out - driven before 2 out - mistake and faded 2 out without threatening

handy early and edged in front before the first - overtaken before the 4th - second at halfway - back in front 5 out - mistake 4 out before being passed and driven before 3 out - faded fast without ever threatening
midfield early - fifth at halfway - driven after 4 out - made a little ground after 3 out without ever threatening and finished well beaten
midfield early - slipped to tenth by halfway - driven and faded before 3 out - failed to threaten and finished well beaten
towards the back of the field early - made ground into fifth by halfway - driven and faded before 3 out to finish well beaten
racing at the back and adrift by five lengths before being driven approaching the 10th and pulled up 4 out
held towards the back and five lengths off the pace before being asked for effort at halfway - pulled up before the 10th
racing at the back throughout - never competitive - allowed to drop away and pulled up after 4 out
midfield early - slipped to twelfth by halfway - driven after the 8th - mistake at the 9th before fading at the back and being pulled up before 3 out
tracked the pace early - slipped to eighth by halfway - faded fast after the 10th and was pulled up well beaten before 4 out
at the tail of the field early - mistake at the 4th - slipped further back by halfway - driven after the 11th - pulled up before 2 out without ever threatening
midfield early - seventh at halfway - mistake 4 out before being allowed to drop away and pulled up
settled in mid-division - pushed along 2f out and shifted right for room - finished strongly through the last furlong - got up in the closing strides to score
dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - made rapid progress 2f out to be handy entering the final furlong - surged to the front near the finish before being caught on the line
handy with the front group early - pushed along beyond 2f out - stayed on through the last furlong but gave up second place close home
close up chasing the pacesetter early - driven along beyond 2f out - dropped back a place with 1f left but stayed on at one speed
raced freely in the early stages - went to the front but faced pressure - driven along 2f out and stayed on into the final furlong - overtaken and had nothing more to give inside the final 110 yards
handy with the front group early - driven along and made progress entering the last furlong - had nothing more inside the final 110 yards
racing in mid-division - pushed along 2f out - faded through the last furlong
racing in mid-division - pushed along beyond 2f out and quickly dropped back a place - faded through the last furlong
in rear throughout
racing in mid-division - pushed along beyond 2f out - faded to the back and was allowed to coast home
raced in mid-division and made ground over 1f out - hit the front approaching the final 110yds - stayed on strongly and kept matters in hand to the line
